workspace_regression.classification: logical buffer view exposed physical colored-slot capacity
workspace_regression.cause: CompilerGraphWorkspace::alias preserved the whole slot byte_size. A 32768-byte imported alias table could be bound through a 524288-byte slot, so GetDimensions allowed generated-instance indices to read unrelated scratch storage.
workspace_regression.fix: Materialize each logical resource as a subrange limited to its declared bytes; preserve slot reuse and allocation identity.

controls.diagnostic_extra_reads: masks failure by changing allocation plan

workspace_regression.after: Seven focused checks pass, including an explicit workspace-growth sequence and all four method-result tests.
